heading: Exportation of timber pulp wood and wood pulp from Alaska
lead: Birch timber and pulp wood or wood pulp manufactured from timber in Alaska may be exported therefrom.

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified to section 422 of Title 48, Territories and Insular Possessions.
Amendments1920—Act June 5, 1920, authorized exportation of birch timber.
